sentences.text: Learned Additional Public Prosecutor Mr.Pranav Trivedi waives service of notice of Rule on behalf of respondent No.1 - State and learned advocate Mr.Sagar Shah waives service of notice of Rule on behalf respondent No.2 - original complainant.

1. The present successive application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, for regular bail in connection with FIR being I-C.R.No.11191067210123 of 2021 registered with Cyber Crime Police Station, Ahmedabad City for offence under Sections 406, 420, 465, 467, 468,
471 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66(c) and 66(d) of the I.T. Act.

sentences.text: 2. Learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that considering the nature of the offence, the R/CR.MA/11750/2022 ORDER DATED: 20/01/2023 applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable conditions.

3. Learned APP appearing on behalf of the respondent - State as well as learned advocate for the original complianant have opposed grant of regular bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.

4. Learned Advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties do not press for further reasoned Roshan Raj S/O Sunil Prasad vs State Of Gujarat on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170820929/

sentences.text: Having heard the learned advocates for the parties and perusing the material placed on record and taking into consideration the facts of the case, nature of allegations, gravity of offences, role attributed to the accused, without discussing the evidence in detail, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.

6. This Court has considered following aspects,
(a) The applicant is in jail since 22.12.2021.
(b) The investigation is over and the charge-sheet is filed and no further custodial interrogation is required.

(c) During the course of custodial interrogation, no recovery and/or discovery is made from the present applicant and now, since the charge-sheet has been filed, no further R/CR.MA/11750/2022 ORDER DATED: 20/01/2023 recovery and/or discovery is required to be made and thereby,
custodial interrogation is not required.
(d) Considering the fact that offences alleged and punishment prescribed thereto is of magistrate triable and keeping in mind the pendency of magistrate court cases, the trial is not likely to be concluded in near future, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the applicant in jail.
(e) Learned APP as well as learned advocate for the original complainant could not pointed out any further incriminating material and/or any past criminal antecedent against the present applicant,
the case of the applicant deserves consideration.
In the facts and circumstances of the present case and considering the role attributed to the applicant and the allegations levelled against him, the case of the applicant deserves consideration and, therefore, I am inclined to consider the case of the applicant.
7.

This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012] 1 SCC 40.
8.
